tasks.label: Git: require clean tree
tasks.detail: Fails if the working tree or index has uncommitted changes. Used as a guard by other tasks.
tasks.command: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || { echo 'Working tree has uncommitted changes — commit or stash first.'; exit 1; }

tasks.label: Git: fetch
tasks.detail: Fetch all remotes and prune deleted remote-tracking branches.

tasks.label: Git: switch develop
tasks.detail: Guard a clean tree, then switch to the integration branch (develop).
tasks.command: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || { echo 'Working tree has uncommitted changes — commit or stash first.'; exit 1; }; git switch develop

tasks.label: Git: reset main to origin
tasks.detail: DESTRUCTIVE: fetches, switches to main and hard-resets it to origin/main. Any local commits on main are discarded.
tasks.command: git switch main && git fetch --all --prune && echo 'Hard-resetting main to origin/main — local commits on main will be lost.' && git reset --hard origin/main

tasks.label: Git: reset develop to origin
tasks.detail: DESTRUCTIVE: fetches, switches to develop and hard-resets it to origin/develop. Any local commits on develop are discarded.
tasks.command: git switch develop && git fetch --all --prune && echo 'Hard-resetting develop to origin/develop — local commits on develop will be lost.' && git reset --hard origin/develop

tasks.label: Git: prune gone branches
tasks.detail: Deletes only local branches that are both merged into main and whose upstream is [gone].
tasks.command: git for-each-ref --merged=main --format='%(refname:short)%09%(upstream:track)' refs/heads | awk -F '\t' '$2 == "[gone]" {print $1}' | while IFS= read -r branch; do [ -n "$branch" ] && git branch -d "$branch"; done

tasks.label: Git: sync repository
tasks.detail: Require a clean tree, fetch, hard-reset both main and develop to their origins, prune gone branches, and end on develop.
